title: Teaching the Child Ṣabr and Avoiding Insistence

text_simplified: The text tells the story of a child who cries and asks his father to buy him a toy, but the father refuses and reminds him of ṣabr (patience) and gratitude. The story aims to teach children the value of contentment and avoiding insistence in making requests. Parents can use this story to reinforce positive behavior in their children.

review_defects.why: The paired Islamic virtues are treated inconsistently: 'ṣabr' is transliterated and glossed, while 'shukr' is translated as 'gratitude' without transliteration. This creates an inconsistent presentation of Islamic terms within the same document.
